from itertools import permutations

# Use constraint programming with backtracking
# p is a permutation of 0..12
# |p[i+1] - p[i]| must be a permutation of 1..12

def solve_all_interval():
    n = 13
    p = [None] * n
    used_vals = [False] * n
    used_diffs = [False] * n  # index 1..12
    
    def backtrack(pos):
        if pos == n:
            return True
        
        for v in range(n):
            if used_vals[v]:
                continue
            
            if pos == 0:
                # Try placing v at position 0
                p[0] = v
                used_vals[v] = True
                if backtrack(1):
                    return True
                used_vals[v] = False
                p[0] = None
            else:
                # Check difference with previous
                diff = abs(v - p[pos-1])
                if diff == 0 or diff > 12:
                    continue
                if used_diffs[diff]:
                    continue
                
                p[pos] = v
                used_vals[v] = True
                used_diffs[diff] = True
                
                if backtrack(pos + 1):
                    return True
                
                p[pos] = None
                used_vals[v] = False
                used_diffs[diff] = False
        
        return False
    
    if backtrack(0):
        return p
    return None

result = solve_all_interval()
print("Solution:", result)
if result:
    diffs = [abs(result[i+1] - result[i]) for i in range(12)]
    print("Differences:", diffs)
    print("Values set:", sorted(result))
    print("Diffs set:", sorted(diffs))
    print("Valid permutation of 0-12:", sorted(result) == list(range(13)))
    print("Valid diffs 1-12:", sorted(diffs) == list(range(1, 13)))

print()
